name: Fujiyama Power Systems Ltd
title: Fujiyama Power Systems Ltd - 544613 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue Rs 9,008mn (+87.5% YoY) and FY26 EBITDA margin 18.5%, but capacity additions are ramping slowly, inventory days rose to 83 from 71, and FY27 guidance is +50% revenue with PAT margin 11-13%.

utilisation.quote: Now at present, we are running around 65%, but we are ramping up and we expect in a month or two it will be around 80%.

capex.quote: we are also setting up a 1,200 megawatt TOPCon solar cell manufacturing facility at Ratlam.

triggers.label: Inventory days 120 → 180
triggers.quote: your inventory days, which has gone up from some 120 to 180

triggers.label: Exit utilisation ~65%
triggers.quote: Now at present, we are running around 65%, but we are ramping up

triggers.label: FY27 revenue guidance +50%
triggers.quote: In current year, our guidance 1s 50% up in revenue, sir.

triggers.label: Bawal 1.3 GWh lead-acid plant fire
triggers.quote: Operations at the facility have been temporarily suspended

guidance.quote: In current year, our guidance 1s 50% up in revenue, sir.
you can consider the guidance 11% to 13% basically for PAT margin.

guidance.horizon: Peak, full utilisation by Q4 FY28
guidance.quote: We can go up to Rs. 5,000 crores in terms of revenue.

red_flags.label: Inventory days up ~50-60%; raw material ~Rs 500 crore+
red_flags.quote: your inventory days, which has gone up from some 120 to 180

red_flags.label: BIS seizure of 2 instances, 10-15 SKUs in question
red_flags.quote: out of 500, I think around 10 to 15 SKUs are there in the question.

red_flags.label: Bawal fire, lead-acid capacity 1.3 GWh suspended
red_flags.quote: The affected facility had a lead-acid battery manufacturing capacity of 1.3 gigawatt

red_flags.label: Management avoids segment volume disclosure
red_flags.quote: we want to avoid details because of competition.

evasions.quote: Sir, I mean, we want to avoid details because of competition.

evasions.topic: Competitive pricing pressure in new southern states
evasions.quote: Yes, sir. Sir, actually, if you see our growth from last year to this year, it is a growth on every state.
PAT margins depend on many things. Mainly it is demand and supply basically which drives the margin.
